note: Text-run scenarios only. Per Sarvam's eval playbook a text run has no speech, so language detection never runs; language changes are requested in words. Voice behaviour (detection, short audio, interruptions, pauses, latency) is in v5-voice-language-test-plan.md.

test_cases.name: Lang: short English yes after a confirmation question
test_cases.user_scenario: Ask for a root canal tomorrow evening. Pick the first time offered and give the name Ravi. When asked to confirm the booking, answer only: Yes. Then say: No, nothing else.

expected_behaviors.name: Short yes understood
expected_behaviors.description: Treats the one-word Yes as confirmation of the booking question just asked and proceeds; does not ask again.

expected_behaviors.name: Short no understood
expected_behaviors.description: Treats No as nothing else needed and closes briefly.

test_cases.name: Lang: short Hindi haan and nahi keep context
test_cases.user_scenario: In English, ask for a tooth removal tomorrow morning and give the name Meena. When asked to confirm the booking, answer only: haan. When asked if you need anything else, answer only: nahi.

expected_behaviors.name: Understands haan
expected_behaviors.description: Treats haan as yes to the booking question and proceeds without asking again.

expected_behaviors.name: Understands nahi
expected_behaviors.description: Treats nahi as no and closes briefly.

expected_behaviors.name: Keeps context
expected_behaviors.description: Keeps the service, date and name.

test_cases.name: Lang: short Telugu avunu and kaadu keep context
test_cases.user_scenario: In English, ask for a root canal tomorrow at 5 PM and give the name Lakshmi. When asked to confirm the booking, answer only: అవును. When asked if you need anything else, answer only: కాదు.

expected_behaviors.name: Understands avunu
expected_behaviors.description: Treats అవును as yes to the booking question and proceeds without asking again.

expected_behaviors.name: Understands kaadu
expected_behaviors.description: Treats కాదు as no and closes briefly.

test_cases.name: Lang: caller asks for Hindi mid-booking
test_cases.user_scenario: In English, ask for a tooth removal tomorrow. After the agent replies, say: Hindi mein baat kijiye. Continue in Hindi, pick a time, give the name Suresh, confirm.

expected_behaviors.name: Switches to Hindi
expected_behaviors.description: Replies in Hindi after the request.

expected_behaviors.name: Keeps context
expected_behaviors.description: Keeps tooth removal and tomorrow; does not restart or ask again.

test_cases.name: Lang: caller asks for Telugu mid-booking
test_cases.user_scenario: In English, ask for a root canal tomorrow evening. After the agent replies, say: Please speak in Telugu. Continue in Telugu, pick a time, give the name Ravi, confirm.

expected_behaviors.name: Switches to Telugu
expected_behaviors.description: Replies in Telugu after the request.

expected_behaviors.name: Keeps context
expected_behaviors.description: Keeps root canal and tomorrow evening; does not restart.

test_cases.name: Lang: caller asks for Gujarati
test_cases.user_scenario: In English, ask the clinic timings. Then say: Please speak in Gujarati. Continue in Gujarati and ask whether tooth removal is available tomorrow.

expected_behaviors.name: Switches to Gujarati
expected_behaviors.description: Replies in Gujarati, not Telugu or Hindi, after the request.

expected_behaviors.name: Correct facts
expected_behaviors.description: Gives the configured hours and offers only real availability.
